context: Binance's 2026-10-31 Recovery Update #3 claims 90% aggregate incident coverage and at least 1:1 coverage for ten named tokens including XRP, based on a 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot. The full zk-SNARK proof is estimated by 2026-11-03.
decisions: Record Binance's top-ten XRP coverage as a primary company assertion with full proof pending.
Do not treat the 90% aggregate incident recovery figure as an XRP-specific purchase or capital-flow quantity.
Keep XRP spot purchases, XRP OTC purchases, SAFU funding, Futures Insurance Fund funding and corporate treasury funding as separate unknown or disclosed categories.
Admit the event to the incident timeline only; do not admit it as a directional price feature until reserve-address and customer-liability reconciliation is complete.
Track Futures Insurance Fund balances separately because its stated purpose includes liquidation-deficit and ADL protection.
Treat Coinbase's reported offline-key changes as a custody/security response, not an XRP demand signal.
Use ETF flow data only with its published session cutoff and distinguish cumulative net flows from current AUM, holdings and actual spot executions.
required_verification: Obtain the October 31 PoR address export and complete zk-SNARK proof when published.
Reconcile XRP reserve addresses and customer net liabilities at the same snapshot time.
Crosswalk all five XRPL incident source wallets against Binance's reserve-address set.
Obtain token-specific replenishment quantities and public/OTC execution evidence before making any actual-capital claim.
Capture daily Futures Insurance Fund balances and compare with liquidation/ADL stress history.
